title: Port model/texture file bundling and image-decoder boundary
scope: Original multi-file pick/drop, companions bytes/reading and pure-Rust PNG/JPEG decoded-image ingress; platform adapters stay thin.
acceptance: Original-versus-Rust file-set order, chosen model, decoded pixels, failed-image omission and persistence inputs compare on licensed fixed fixtures.
Image dependencies require explicit license/purity decision before adoption; no browser/C++ decoding hidden in the Rust product.
open_items: Complete file-selection/identity/byte-preservation slice tracked in io.obj.companions.files; drop traversal and image decoding remain separate continuations.

Image candidate audit under io.obj.companions.image_audit is complete, but raw decoder pixel compatibility failed and no dependency is adopted. Browser canvas/PNG/JPEG/BMP/WebP semantics, malformed omission and 3MF packed images remain open; parent stays planned.
